integrity: The primary forward model and entropy-production expression are credited; this result is a derived exact inverse classification. Computational diagnostics do not substitute for the analytical proof. No external scientific certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The model assumes symmetric two-state switching with known harmonic relaxation and independent Gaussian noise.
State labels can be recovered only up to exchange; equal diffusivities are excluded because their rate is unidentifiable.
The conclusions apply to exact stationary moments, not finite-sample estimators or observations at multiple times.
title: Sharp eighth-moment identification of hidden diffusivity switching and dissipation
